But you are right that "lower symmetry" correlates with "higher memory consumption".

And yes, it is not exactly the inverse. Expand really always goes up to `S1` whereas reduce tries its best. There are standalone methods for each conversion which a user can use to their liking if they want to achieve a specific symmetry.

So to summarize:
- `expand`: any to S1
- `reduce`: any to as low memory consumption as possible (highest symmetry) [I think you mixed this up above]
